verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Solid's bare-metal, minimal abstractions give direct DOM access for using native libraries like D3, and real DOM elements are inspectable via devtools, which is corroborated by community reports of using Solid for data-viz work with granular reactive control. Missing for 10: no concrete hands-on example/tutorial of integrating a specific charting library (e.g., D3 or Chart.js) walked through, and only one independent voice confirms real-world data-viz usage.
